title: Nested Drop Computation
statement: Let $m\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, let $z$ be a bit string, and let $q\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $q\le 2|\langle z,\mathrm{bits}(q)\rangle|$. On input $h=\langle z,\mathrm{bits}(q)\rangle$, the specified computation starting in its copy state, with pointer register $2|z|+2$, query register $q$, tail register $2|z|+2$, all other registers zero, and no answer, halts with the answer that is true exactly when either $q$ is less than the length of the transformed word (if $m$ is true) or its $q$-th bit is $1$ (if $m$ is false). Every configuration before halting satisfies the stated computation invariant and has each register at most $4|h|+4$.
